question: What is the value of (144)/(33) of (11)/(12)-(132)/(13) of (52)/(12)?
solution:
**Given:**

(144)/(33) times (11)/(12) - (132)/(13) times (52)/(12)

Concept Used 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf549d8ed75068c5cb44a816a55d9099b0dc62c590018619be535a10a0dde6b1.png] 

**Calculation:**

(144 times 11)/(33 times 12) - (132 times 52)/(13 times 12)

⇒ (1584)/(396) - (6864)/(156)

⇒ 4 - 44

⇒ -40

**The value of the expression is -40.**
